data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 送信路线
data.description: 今天的地址有点多，她在地图上逐个圈出来，规划出一条不用绕远路的路线。
data.promptProse: Angelina sits on a sun-dappled park bench, studying a folding delivery route map marked with vibrant sticky note tabs. Her scuffed leather courier satchel and a stainless steel thermos flask rest beside her as crisp morning light filters through the trees.
data.animaCaption: Tracing a delivery loop with her ballpoint pen on the folding map, she takes a quick sip from her thermos, energized for the morning route.
